column2: Spatial Contortion is banned in Pauper (not just non-legal)
column3: Tournament policy: a format's banned list (and an MTGO special case), not how the game plays, as for the same note on Circle of Flame (rulings-P079) and Hada Freeblade (rulings-P183). The data has Pauper not_legal, not banned, for all three (docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md, "Not yet investigated"); the deck check keeps the card out of a Pauper deck either way (tests/rulings/r_p059_fling_flowstone.rs).
